title: Private production seller preparation profile
description: Schema only. Actual values remain CurrentUser DPAPI ciphertext in the ignored local profile. No account, submission, control verification, activation, cron, ACL, wallet signature or deployment is implied by a prepared profile.

providerOrigin.description: Exact permanent alias verified by read-only Vercel metadata on 2026-10-11; availability and the new production runtime are still unaccepted.

workerOrigin.description: Same permanent project origin; scheduler stays disabled.

card.description: Validated by native createSellerCard and marketCard; exact text service, GAHV Testnet recipient, official USDC and price 0.01. No wallet private key.

account.description: Populated only from the same native creation receipt and independently resolved human/agent/recovery identities, generation one.

config.description: Validated by validateSellerConfiguration after account binding, with own agent/provider accesses and no preview protection fields.

submission.description: Authentic native submission response only. Its server-issued challenge remains unverified until independent public control proof is reviewed.

gate.description: Durable consumed gate is appended before a native write. A lost acknowledgement permits read-only recovery of the same IDs; no automatic write retry or phase reset.

private32.description: Generated locally and stored only in CurrentUser DPAPI ciphertext. Never a public output or environment text file.

x-procedure: Root obtains read-only sanitized permanent Vercel alias evidence, freezes runtime/provider hashes and reviews the helper before running preparation.
Generate fresh accesses, stable UUIDs and text card locally; seal prepared profile with CurrentUser DPAPI, fsync and roundtrip. This has no Redis or remote effects.
After exact root coordination, consume the sealed create gate before calling createRedisWorkspaceStore.createWorkspace once in the new production family. Keep public registration paused.

If outcome is uncertain, use the native creation replay lookup with admission disabled and a Redis READ-only adapter; verify the same creationId, hashes and three identities. Never issue another creation write or reset the gate.

Verify all three native identities and generation one; grant market:submit through the human principal with one stable changeId and expectedRevision zero, sealing a gate before the write. Recovery checks the exact persisted changeId and native digest through a validated READ-only snapshot.

Submit the frozen card through the native submitMarketService function with explicitly coordinated production stores, or later submit_market_service on the published MCP. Preserve submissionId and recover with readMarketSubmission/get_market_submission; do not synthesize review evidence.

Obtain the actual server challenge for the permanent hostname and prepare its exact public proof separately. Publishing the proof, independent HTTP verification, manual review and service activation remain later steps.

Prepare scoped worker ACL/AES/config/application hash and own CRON secret only through separately reviewed controls. No principal Redis token, wallet signer, test payment bypass or preview protection is part of the worker config.
Worker, text endpoint, purchases and cron stay disabled until candidate/configuration/evidence are presented and the corresponding action is approved.
x-source-policy: The preparation helper verifies all exact 22 effective provider file hashes and no cron before generating or sealing a real profile. A stale source manifest fails closed.
